configuration.description: Non-sensitive configuration values as an HCL object. These will be visible in Terraform plan output.

configuration_json.description: The merged JSON configuration (non-sensitive + sensitive) for passing to an airbyte_source or airbyte_destination resource's `configuration` attribute.

configuration_secrets.description: Sensitive configuration values (API keys, passwords, etc.) as an HCL object. These are hidden in Terraform plan output. Keys here are deep-merged with (and override) keys in `configuration`.

connector_registry.description: Controls where the connector spec is fetched from. Accepted values: `cloud` fetches from the Cloud registry, `oss` fetches from the OSS registry, and `composite` (default) tries Cloud first then falls back to OSS. You can also provide a full URL (starting with `http://` or `https://`) or an absolute file path (starting with `/`) to override the spec source entirely.

connector_spec_json.description: The connector's `connectionSpecification` JSONSchema, as a JSON string. Useful for debugging or downstream tooling.

connector_version.description: The version of the connector (e.g. `2.0.0`). If not specified, the latest version is used. When set, the connector spec for that exact version is fetched and used for JSONSchema validation.

definition_id.description: The UUID of the connector definition, resolved from `connector_name`.

docker_image_tag.description: The resolved Docker image tag (version) of the connector.

ignore_errors.description: If true, validation errors (including JSONSchema validation) are reported as warnings instead of errors. Defaults to false.

block.description:
Resolves and merges connector configuration for use with airbyte_source or airbyte_destination resources.

This data source resolves a connector name (and optional version) to its definition ID, fetches the
connector's JSONSchema spec, validates configuration against it, and merges non-sensitive and sensitive
configuration into a single JSON blob suitable for passing to a resource.
